'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Ganden Yanaga LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
